summary: Platform engineer working across infrastructure and application code. I build and run the delivery path — CI pipelines, containers, environments — and I am equally at home in the product code that runs on top of it. I care about systems that are easy to deploy, easy to observe, and easy for the next person to change.

highlights: Build and maintain the CI/CD pipelines the team ships through.
Containerize services and keep development, staging, and production environments consistent.
Work on the application code as well as the platform, from API endpoints to the interfaces in front of them.
Set up logging and monitoring so failures are found before users report them.
